DESCRIPTION:
Ndias first gated golf community
The flagship project of group silverglades, the tarudhan valley golf resort is indias first gated golf community. With boundaries spanning across 65 green acres; The tarudhan valley has been carefully designed to include exotic golf homes dotted around a exceptionally designed 9-Hole golf course by graham cooke. The valley offers apartments, villas and balinese style wooden cottages for gracious living, as well as a well-Appointed clubhouse, resort hotel, conferencing facilities and golf driving range. At the tarudhan valley its the country life at its absolute best.

Golf course :

The 9-Hole course has been beautifully designed by graham cooke, a five time canadian amateur champion. Now a quebec based architect, cooke is known for his classic design philosophy mixed with a modern sensitivity for environmental concerns. Like a fine craftsman, he believes in attention to detail and a hands-On approach.

The course
The most impressive aspect of the course is the restraint employed in its design. Not an oversized monster, it is eminently playable. The course offers three distinct and imaginative styles woven through the nine holes. The first three holes are planned as links-Styled golf, with large rolling greens embracing the look of famous courses like st. Andrews and the royal troon. The following four holes are dedicated to some of the world's best parkland courses - The first of which replicates augusta national's famed par three twelfth. And finally, the course finishes with two exceptional mediterranean-Syled holes. The orchard trees, water, sandy areas, rocky outcrops and clusters of colorful shrubs capture the character of courses such as valderrama in spain and pebble beach in california. Overall, each round is full of anticipation and players never tire of playing this enjoyable and imaginative course. Like all gated golf communities abroad the golf course is exclusively for property owners.

The residences :

Tarudhan valley golf homes are designed to offer the pleasures of country living in residences situated around a landscaped, golf course. This self contained community has a choice of homes one bedroom studio apartments and two and three bedroom villas overlooking golf fairways.

The conference centre offers three individual conference venues with state of the art equipment and conference facilities. Two of the conference halls have a capacity of 120 & 80 guests respectively while a boardroom accommodates 25 guests.

The lush lawns which open up to both conference rooms are perfect for banquets, cocktail dinners, live performances and theme dinners for up to 500 guests offering the best of global cuisine and the finest service.
